column1: # Reviewed rows for the September sync baseline's top unmatched makers
# (AUREO-1350) and the Waves V17 gap seen in one real sync (AUREO-1286).
#   identifier `-` adds the version alone. Every row names vst3, a format the
#   entry already lists, so no row adds a format.
# 197 Waves entries listed 17.1.42 beside 16.7.33; these 54 listed 16.7.33
# alone (49) or no version at all (5), so an installed 16.7.33 read as
# current. Waves versions its whole bundle together: 17.1.42 is the one V17
# shell version every refreshed entry carries
# (2026-09-kvr-studio-manager-scan.tsv says the same of the KVR lane).
# Checked per product, 2026-10-10, because AUREO-1286 warned the only-16
# entries could be products Waves dropped in V17. None were:
#   - Waves release notes, 2026-06-23: "All Waves Plugins: Across-the-board
#     software update to V17". No release note from May 2023 on names a
#     plugin discontinued or left out of V17. The 2026-06-23 Preset Menu
#     exception list (Q-Clone, Curves, IR1, IRLive, GTR Series, Tune
#     Real-Time, X-Noise, Z-Noise) is a missing feature, not a removal.
#   - Each entry's own waves.com product page is live, carries no
#     "Product Discontinued" note (Waves uses one, on the CA1000/CA2000
#     engine records), and lists V17 in its supported versions
#     ("V17, V16, ... V9" on most; Clarix LB "V17, V16"; Lil Tube and
#     Spherix from V14; the two StudioVerse products from V15). Fourteen are
#     bundle-only (C360/M360/R360/S360, the DTS Neural trio, GTR3 Amps/
#     Stomps/ToolRack/Tuner, the L3 variants) and still list V17.
# Not written here, noticed on the way:
#   waves-studiorack is StudioVerse Audio Effects (renamed 2024-06-24 per the
#   release notes); its name already says so, only the slug is old. Slugs are
#   ids for Studio, so it stays.
#   waves-rs56 / waves-the-king-s-microphones still duplicate their abbey-road-*
# The baseline (racks tools/reports/data/baseline.json) is an aggregate: 227
# unmatched, five maker strings, no rows. The row-level
# `catalog_unmatched_plugin` events live only in the gitignored Aptabase CSV
# exports (`*-release.csv`), which are in neither repo. No identifier is
# written without a row that observed it, so this pass has none to write:
#   sonible   installers sit behind downloads10.sonible.com, whose robots.txt
#             is `Disallow: /`, so the installer-introspection lane may not
#             read them. 14 of 23 entries still carry no identifier.
#   waves     Waves Central only; no public installer to introspect.
#   uaudio    UA Connect only; AUREO-1286's LA-2A Gray (U3A7) already landed
#             in catalog#922, and Topline Vocal Suite already lists 1.1.11.
#   Open Audio Stack registry covers open-source plugins, none of these makers.
